description: Hides every face in one of the user's photos, as a new photo, paid from their credits: effect blur or pixelate, strength 0 (light) to 100 (strong). The faces are found by Luala; with none found nothing is started or charged. To keep some faces sharp or hide one it missed, the user opens the photo's link and uses Blur faces in the app. Pass the price the user agreed to as max_credits: the photo's prices from get_shoot or list_photos name it. If a call to this tool got no answer, it may already have started: check list_photos before calling it again.
name: blur_faces
title: Blur the faces in a photo
